accountsPage.title: Accounts
accountsPage.overview: Every ROCO account shares the same affordable minimum deposit — so you choose by trading style and features, not by cost. Two families, six accounts, one login.
accountsPage.centsNote: All values (deposits, profits, etc.) are in cents.
accountsPage.bannerTitle: Found your account? Open it in minutes and start trading.

a1.d: Pay through the spread on Lion, or raw spread plus a fixed commission on Cheetah. No hidden costs.

a2.d: Forex, metals, commodities, stocks, crypto and indices — all from one MT5 login.

a3.d: Trade full-size, or switch to a Nano cent account to test strategies with minimal risk.

a4.d: Social Trade lets you follow and copy top traders, or become a provider others follow.

lion.intro: The Lion family keeps it simple: you pay only through a spread from 1.2 pips, with no commission. Start standard, go cent-sized with Nano-Lion, or copy top traders with Lion Social Trade.
lion.stdNote: Full-size trading with no deposit, balance or withdrawal caps — for beginners who want simple, transparent conditions.
lion.nanoNote: The same spread-only setup in cents. Smaller stakes, real market experience, minimized risk.
lion.socialNote: Follow and automatically copy Lion providers — hands-off trading on the same conditions.
lion.tag: For beginners and traders seeking simpler trading.

cheetah.intro: The Cheetah family is built for speed and precision: raw spreads with a defined commission, so your costs stay tight and predictable. Choose standard, cent-sized Nano-Cheetah, or Cheetah Social Trade.
cheetah.stdNote: Raw spreads with an $8 commission per lot — for professionals who value speed and defined costs.
cheetah.nanoNote: Raw-spread trading in cents with an 8-cent commission. Practise pro conditions with minimal risk.
cheetah.socialNote: Follow and copy Cheetah providers on the same raw-spread, commission-based conditions.
cheetah.tag: For professional traders who value speed and precision.

faqPage.title: FAQ
faqPage.overview: Answers to the questions we hear most — accounts, deposits, spreads, platforms and support. Can't find yours? Our team is one message away.

openAccount.q: How can I open an account?
openAccount.a: Visit rocobroker.com and complete the registration form. After creating your account, you must also complete the KYC identity verification process.

minDeposit.q: What is the minimum deposit amount?
minDeposit.a: There is no minimum deposit amount.

methods.q: What deposit and withdrawal methods do you offer?
methods.a: Iranian Rial via {rialProvider}, plus BTC, ETH, USDT, and USDC on various networks. More methods are coming soon.

withdrawTime.q: How long does it take to process my withdrawal request?
withdrawTime.a: Withdrawals are processed on the same business day.

commissions.q: What are your commissions and spreads?
commissions.a: Lion Account: spreads start from 1.2 pips with no commission. Cheetah Account: raw spreads with an $8 commission per lot.

islamic.a: Currently, Islamic accounts are not available, but they will be introduced soon.

scalping.a: Yes, our broker supports scalping and hedging strategies.

spreadsNews.q: Why do spreads widen during economic news releases?
spreadsNews.a: Market volatility and reduced liquidity during major economic announcements widen spreads; they normalize afterwards.

orderClosed.a: A margin call is triggered at {marginCallLevel}. Automatic position closure can begin at the {stopOutLevel} stop-out level.

regulated.a: {companyName} is listed by {regulatorName} as an active authorised brokerage company under licence {licenseNumber}. Company registration: {registrationNumber}.

demo.q: Do you offer a demo account?
demo.a: Yes, you can activate a demo account with $10,000 virtual funds through your user panel.

iranianRials.q: Can I deposit using Iranian Rials?
iranianRials.a: Yes. Iranian Rial deposits are available through {rialProvider}.

depositMissing.q: Why is my deposit not showing in my account?
depositMissing.a: Verify your account number and contact support; for crypto deposits, provide your TXID.

robots.a: Yes, you can use Expert Advisors (EAs) on MetaTrader 5. You are responsible for their performance.

education.a: Yes, our educational section is under development and will include articles, videos, and webinars.

leverage.q: Can I change my account leverage?
leverage.a: Yes, you can change your account leverage through your user panel.

microLots.q: Can I trade with micro lots?
microLots.a: Yes, you can trade with small lot sizes such as 0.01 lot (micro lots).

dailyAnalysis.q: Do you provide daily analysis or economic news?
dailyAnalysis.a: Daily market analysis and economic news are shared via our Telegram and Instagram channels.

cookies.externalBlockedBody: Enable external market data in Cookie settings to load this TradingView widget.
cookies.analyticsBody: Anonymous statistics that show which pages are useful — no personal data, no cross-site tracking.
